$description: Token proposals for ChatInput (carbon-labs v12). Moves to packages/themes at graduation, or is dropped if Carbon covers it another way. Values are aliases to Carbon's own tokens where one exists.

background.$description: The composer's fill. Carbon's $chat-prompt-background is white in light, which holds; in dark it is $background (#161616), but the input is the shell, one step below the page, so FileChip ($layer-02) steps up from it. In carbon#23376's v12 dark theme the shell is $layer-03 (#0c0d0f). The g90/g100 alias reads the v12 tier: under v11's g100, $layer-03 is #525252, which is why this is a proposal and not a value. Falls back to $chat-prompt-background.

menu-selected.$description: A selected row in the composer's menus. Carbon's Menu marks selection with a checkmark only; this adds ADR 0020's blue-gray tint at the selected step, the same value as MegaButton's selected fill so a selected control reads the same everywhere. The menus are inverse, so a light page shows the g100 value. Falls back to $layer-selected.

menu-selected-text.$description: The label of a selected menu row: the brand blue solved for contrast on chat-input-menu-selected, the same value as MegaButton's selected text. Falls back to $text-primary.
